access_details.search_key: STRAP (exact punctuation critical — must match the portal's format)
access_details.browser_flows_status: referenced by skills; not yet published in oracle-node main

sources.completeness_check: MVL (mirror-validation) global completeness >= 0.8 per prepared/transformed pair, enforced by oracle-node workflow/lambdas/mvl; plus seed-count vs prepared-count reconciliation

access_details.browser_required: detail pages require a real browser
access_details.adapter: lee-accela.mjs (oracle-node permit-harvest worker; referenced by skills, not yet published)

sources.refresh_method: property-first harvest from the seed for permit-eligible parcels (commercial/industrial usage types; env PROPERTY_FIRST_PERMIT_ELIGIBLE_USAGE_TYPES)
gotchas: Detail page may display a different parcel than the one searched — permits must be linked via propertyFirstTarget (the requested parcel), never the displayed parcel
Parcel-id format differs from the appraiser's STRAP; normalization required

urls.bulk: Data Access portal; exact bulk URL undocumented in skills — Cloudflare-challenged, browser required

sources.refresh_method: quarterly corporate bulk cordata.zip (~1.7 GB) plus daily incrementals (YYYYMMDDc.txt); county scoping by ZIP-prefix matching (--lee-county-zips convenience flag; ZIP list lives in the not-yet-published enqueue script)
sources.completeness_check: invalidRecordCount == 0 && transformedRecordCount == sourceRecordCount, from the transform summary
gotchas: cordata.zip is ZIP method 9 (Deflate64) — streaming libs fail in Lambda; expand locally and stage the .txt entries to S3, then run with --source-format text

access_details.harvester: Puppeteer via harvest-bbb-category.mjs (referenced by skills, not yet published)

anti_bot.headless: default; use --headless false for datacenter-IP challenges

sources.matching: joined to permits by contractor name
